description: Transcribe audio with Groq Whisper (whisper-large-v3). $0.005 per minute of audio, per-second prorated — NOT a flat per-call price: billed seconds = ceil(parsed duration to whole seconds); charge = ceil(seconds x 5000 / 60) USDC units (SOL rail: ceil(seconds x 34000 / 60) lamports), quoted exactly by the free preflight (POST /toll/transcribe/preflight) before payment. Accepts WAV/PCM, MP3, Ogg Opus/Vorbis, FLAC, MP4/M4A audio-only (max 25 MB, max 600 s); WebM refused at v1. The MCP adapter converts the tool arguments into the multipart HTTP shape (file part + optional language/model fields). You only pay for delivered answers — any failure after settlement queues an automatic refund. — USDC on Solana via x402 (over MCP: call without payment to get the PaymentRequired challenge, then retry with the payment at _meta["x402/payment"]). HTTP equivalent: POST https://exchangerebel.com/toll/transcribe.
